items.name: Pesaro Open 2022
items.information:
## **FFP2 MASKS ARE MANDATORY**
Please check the [COVID-19 tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PesaroOpen2022#17406-covid-19) to understand the safety rules enforced at this competition.
**Note: you will have to pay extra at the venue €10 if you are not a Cubing Italy member.
It's free, discover how to in the [Registration tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PesaroOpen2022#17405-registration-registrazione).**

---

## **MASCHERINE FFP2 OBBLIGATORIE**
Consulta la [sezione COVID-19](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PesaroOpen2022#17406-covid-19) per comprendere le norme di sicurezza della competizione.
**Nota: dovrai pagare altri €10 in loco se non ti associ a Cubing Italy.
È gratis, scopri come nella [sezione Registrazione](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PesaroOpen2022#17405-registration-registrazione).**
